limits: Five-minute preview inactivity is crossed with a controllable service clock; the actual isolated daemon uses a two-second idle interval. The normal daily five-plus-five-minute duration was not waited out in this run.
Human insertion raises only the private headless browser or a browser on an inactive Windows desktop. It does not raise the ordinary user browser.
The requested keep list is not a complete inventory of pages preserved by native safety. Prefilled/unknown forms and human-touched/borrowed pages remain protected.
Screenshot paths are temporary local artifacts: copy and verify the desired delivery file before ordinary temporary-folder cleanup.
No upstream CLI/daemon binary or Harness core update, no automatic input replay, no general speed ratio claim.
